question: Should imsg adopt `send-sticker` and `send.sticker` as a maintained advanced-bridge contract?
rationale: The implementation and exact-head proof establish current behavior, but only maintainers can accept the durable support commitment for reverse-engineered private IMCore selectors across macOS releases.

options.title: Adopt guarded sticker API
options.body: Merge the single fail-closed surface and maintain its selector compatibility across supported macOS versions.

options.title: Require broader version proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until standalone and attached sends are demonstrated on additional supported macOS versions.

options.title: Decline private stickers
options.body: Close the PR if the long-term undocumented-framework support surface is outside imsg's intended scope.

recommendation.title: Adopt guarded sticker API
recommendation.body: Merge the single fail-closed surface and maintain its selector compatibility across supported macOS versions.
